source.description: A reviewed six-panel raster contact sheet showing one consistent right-facing woolly sheep progressing from pale construction to a finished graphite and restrained colored-pencil sketch.
source.notes: The process must keep one side-view sheep with one rounded fleece body, one dark face, two ears, exactly four legs, one small tail, one collar, and one bell. No horn, extra leg, background animal, or final-only feature is allowed.

process_strategy: Lock the sheep to one right-facing side view, establish the fleece envelope, head, four leg routes, tail, collar, and bell footprint early, then add wool rhythm, facial landmarks, grass, graphite value, and restrained color only on those established forms.

final_elements.name: right-facing fleece, head, leg, and ground construction
final_elements.description: One large body oval with a scalloped-fleece envelope, a smaller lowered head wedge, exactly four leg axes, and one short ground line.

final_elements.name: tail, ear, collar, and bell guides
final_elements.description: One small rear tail, two ear routes, a neck collar line, and one reserved bell shape beneath the throat.

final_elements.name: complete sheep silhouette
final_elements.description: The woolly body, dark face, two ears, four separated legs with hooves, small tail, collar, and bell wrapped around the pale guides.

final_elements.name: eye, nostril, mouth, hoof splits, and bell clapper
final_elements.description: One calm visible eye, one nostril, a short mouth line, four simple hoof splits, and one small clapper inside the established bell.

final_elements.name: fleece curls, ear folds, collar buckle, and grass tufts
final_elements.description: Grouped scalloped fleece marks, light ear folds, one collar buckle, and three small grass tufts around the existing ground line.

final_elements.name: graphite values, restrained pencil color, and soft shadow
final_elements.description: Soft graphite on the face and legs, warm-gray fleece shading, muted brass on the bell, dusty green grass, and one broken cast shadow.

rejection_checks: The same right-facing sheep, scale, body proportions, head angle, and ground placement must persist in all six panels.
Exactly four legs, two ears, one tail, one collar, and one bell must appear before the final panel and persist through the finish.
No horn, extra leg, missing hoof, new facial feature, grass tuft, shadow, or color area may first appear in the final panel.
No adjacent frame may look unchanged at card size, and the finish must remain a believable 15-30 minute handmade sketch rather than polished animal illustration.
